segment.source: I spoke to Harold today at the bar. He sure had a couple of good things to say about you, friend.<end>
segment.target: I spoke to Harold today at the bar. He sure had a couple of good things to say about you, friend.<end>

segment.source: <end>

segment.source: What are you doing?<end>
segment.target: What are you doing?<end>

segment.source: I'm helping with clearing up the tunnel by using telekinetic manipulation.<end>
segment.target: I'm helping with clearing up the tunnel by using telekinetic manipulation.<end>

segment.source: What do you know about Patrick Pierce's death?<end>
segment.target: What do you know about Patrick Pierce's death?<end>

segment.source: Oh, that happened a while ago; I thought we were done with that. I don't know what to tell you, the man died in his sleep. That's all I remember.<end>
segment.target: Oh, that happened a while ago; I thought we were done with that. I don't know what to tell you, the man died in his sleep. That's all I remember.<end>

segment.source: Can you tell me what he was like as a person?<end>
segment.target: Can you tell me what he was like as a person?<end>

segment.source: We never hung out all that much, but he did not seem like a bad person to me. Relaxed and focused on his work, that's how I'd describe him. If memory serves me right, I think someone told me he was in the midst of the Core City riots, back when Biocorp fell apart. I most certainly don't envy him for that, if you dig.<end>

segment.source: Can you teach me psi abilities?<end>
segment.target: Can you teach me psi abilities?<end>

segment.source: I can teach you psychokinetics, if you are interested. I'm afraid I'll have to charge you.<end>
segment.target: I can teach you psychokinetics, if you are interested. I'm afraid I'll have to charge you.<end>

segment.source: <end>

segment.source: That's alright, what can you teach me?<end>
segment.target: That's alright, what can you teach me?<end>

segment.source: When it comes to psionics, I can teach you telekinetic punch, force field, force emission and electrokinesis.<end>
segment.target: When it comes to psionics, I can teach you telekinetic punch, force field, force emission and electrokinesis.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: What is a telekinetic punch exactly?<end>
segment.target: What is a telekinetic punch exactly?<end>

segment.source:
It's when you focus your mind to create a telekinetic ball and launch it at your target. Impact is often so strong that if you hit a living target with it you're likely to stun it for a short while.
I can teach you this ability for fifty credits.<end>

segment.source: Mhm?<end>
segment.target: Mhm?<end>

segment.source: Why do you have to charge me?<end>
segment.target: Why do you have to charge me?<end>

segment.source: I'm not a scavenger and I'm not a manufacturer. Teaching is how I get by.<end>
segment.target: I'm not a scavenger and I'm not a manufacturer. Teaching is how I get by.<end>

segment.source: Forget it then.<end>
segment.target: Forget it then.<end>

segment.source: I want to learn some psi abilities.<end>
segment.target: I want to learn some psi abilities.<end>

segment.source: Where did you learn to use psionics? Is there some psionic guru roaming the Underrail?<end>
segment.target: Where did you learn to use psionics? Is there some psionic guru roaming the Underrail?<end>

segment.source: ::He laughs.:: Perhaps there is, friend, but the man who taught me was far from a guru. He knew a few techniques, and I had some coins. We exchanged. It was the bare basics, but it got me started. Refined the rest on my own.<end>
segment.target: ::He laughs.:: Perhaps there is, friend, but the man who taught me was far from a guru. He knew a few techniques, and I had some coins. We exchanged. It was the bare basics, but it got me started. Refined the rest on my own.<end>

segment.source: Any more teachers you know of?<end>
segment.target: Any more teachers you know of?<end>

segment.source: Sure, you got two in SGS. Beside me, of course. Ezra can teach you thought control abilities, while Quinton's an expert in metathermics. <end>
segment.target: Sure, you got two in SGS. Beside me, of course. Ezra can teach you thought control abilities, while Quinton's an expert in metathermics. <end>

segment.source: And I hear there's another psionic at the bar, stuck because of the earthquake. <end>
segment.target: And I hear there's another psionic at the bar, stuck because of the earthquake. <end>

segment.source: There's also the possibility of undergoing cerebral imprinting with psionic mentors, but I'm not a fan of those.<end>
segment.target: There's also the possibility of undergoing cerebral imprinting with psionic mentors, but I'm not a fan of those.<end>

segment.source: Why? What's wrong with it?<end>
segment.target: Why? What's wrong with it?<end>

segment.source:
I prefer... the natural way. It works better for me. Imprinting might be a shortcut to ability, but it is not a shortcut to wisdom.
Also, while most psionic mentors are safe if used properly, some use low-quality or modified devices and eventually end up derailed, no different than Lunatics. I heard... a while ago I think, a story about some junkies who didn't even use them for psionic reasons at all, but heavily modified them to get some kind of... high.<end>

segment.source: But that is a whole different story. Again, if you obtain them from reliable sources, they are safe to use, friend.<end>

segment.source: I'll keep that in mind. I had other questions.<end>
segment.target: I'll keep that in mind. I had other questions.<end>

segment.source: What are your thoughts on the Faceless invasion?<end>
segment.target: What are your thoughts on the Faceless invasion?<end>

segment.source: If I would have to guess, I'd say that the Core City probably overstepped some boundaries and messed with the Underrail infrastructure in a way that was harmful for the Faceless.<end>
segment.target: If I would have to guess, I'd say that the Core City probably overstepped some boundaries and messed with the Underrail infrastructure in a way that was harmful for the Faceless.<end>

segment.source: I say this because if you look to the past, at the actual credible accounts of Faceless attacks, it was usually a battle over some key infrastructural element, such as master ventilation or energy grid node.<end>
segment.target: I say this because if you look to the past, at the actual credible accounts of Faceless attacks, it was usually a battle over some key infrastructural element, such as master ventilation or energy grid node.<end>

segment.source: So you think they might have rerouted some power or air flow to the detriment of the Faceless?<end>
segment.target: So you think they might have rerouted some power or air flow to the detriment of the Faceless?<end>

segment.source: If I'd have to guess, yes. We don't know to what extent the Faceless rely on the Underrail systems, but they are humans, I think, or living beings at least, so they have to breathe. And their machines have to be powered somehow.<end>
segment.target: If I'd have to guess, yes. We don't know to what extent the Faceless rely on the Underrail systems, but they are humans, I think, or living beings at least, so they have to breathe. And their machines have to be powered somehow.<end>

segment.source: I see.<end>
segment.target: I see.<end>

segment.source: But, again, I'm just guessing.<end>
segment.target: But, again, I'm just guessing.<end>

segment.source: What are your thoughts on the Faceless retreat from Core City?<end>
segment.target: What are your thoughts on the Faceless retreat from Core City?<end>

segment.source: Seeing how long the siege lasted, I'm a bit surprised it ended without any more bloodshed. I suppose the Faceless got whatever they wanted, because it doesn't seem to me like they didn't have enough forces to take over the city.<end>
segment.target: Seeing how long the siege lasted, I'm a bit surprised it ended without any more bloodshed. I suppose the Faceless got whatever they wanted, because it doesn't seem to me like they didn't have enough forces to take over the city.<end>

segment.source: Basing that on the news I heard, though. Regardless, things are definitely quieter now in Underrail.<end>
segment.target: Basing that on the news I heard, though. Regardless, things are definitely quieter now in Underrail.<end>

segment.source: What are your thoughts on Tanner's disappearance?<end>
segment.target: What are your thoughts on Tanner's disappearance?<end>

segment.source: I'm as confused as everybody, friend. As if the recent goings-on weren't mind-boggling enough, now we have to figure out this mystery as well.<end>
segment.target: I'm as confused as everybody, friend. As if the recent goings-on weren't mind-boggling enough, now we have to figure out this mystery as well.<end>

segment.source: And Tanner was, I think, the biggest mystery out of all the odd people in this station. No one ever talked about it, but we all thought it.<end>
segment.target: And Tanner was, I think, the biggest mystery out of all the odd people in this station. No one ever talked about it, but we all thought it.<end>

segment.source: You mentioned Lunatics. What can you tell me about them?<end>
segment.target: You mentioned Lunatics. What can you tell me about them?<end>

segment.source:
A gang of - lunatics. Pretty much. They are all capable of invoking psionics, but that comes at the cost of their minds. Some say they became that way due to overdosing on psi-enhancing concoctions and strong inhalants, others say it's due to cerebral imprinting gone wrong. And there are other stories as well.
You'll hear a lot about Lunatics, but one thing always rings true - they are not to be underestimated.<end>

segment.source: They are rare here in the southern parts, but as you begin to approach Core City, and especially once you go to Upper Underrail, that's where you're most likely to encounter them.<end>
